no_adcom_quote.quote: No AC meeting was held for this application.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the vibegron (Gemtesa) NDA. The medical review states plainly that no AC meeting was held, and the Office Director memorandum explains the rationale: mirabegron, the first-in-class beta-3 receptor agonist, had already been taken to advisory committee before its approval, and vibegron has similar efficacy without unique safety issues, so FDA determined there was no need for external expertise to inform approvability. (The summary review's mention of a 2012 BRUDAC meeting refers to mirabegron, a different drug, not this application.)
